rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for a formal binding international treaty.

example.english: The two countries formally signed a treaty and promised to end hostilities.
example.traditional: 兩國正式簽署條約，承諾停止敵對行動。
example.jyutping: loeng5 gwok3 zing3 sik1 cim1 cyu5 tiu4 joek3 sing4 nok6 ting4 zi2 dik6 deoi3 hang4 dung6

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing a formal agreement between particular countries or organizations rather than the treaty as a legal instrument.

example.english: The two countries signed a treaty on fisheries cooperation.
example.traditional: 兩國就漁業合作簽署協定。
example.jyutping: loeng5 gwok3 zau6 jyu4 jip6 hap6 zok3 cim1 cyu5 hip3 ding6

rows.note: Use this when the agreement is being presented as the result of negotiation and may be less specifically a binding treaty.

example.english: After several rounds of negotiations, the two countries finally agreed on a treaty.
example.traditional: 經過多輪談判，兩國終於同意一份協議。
example.jyutping: ging1 gwo3 do1 leon4 taam4 pun3 loeng5 gwok3 zung1 jyu1 tung4 ji3 jat1 fan6 hip3 ji5
